༄༅/ /sa bka' rnying gsum dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba snying po'i don gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa bka' rnying gsum dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba snying po'i don gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/na mo buddha ya/ skyob pa nyid rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen/ dang thog mar mjal tshe/ bdag la bka' bstsal ba/ dus 'khor la 'dris che ba'i bgro bar 'dug pa/ rtsa rgyud phal cher la/ dbu rang du e waṃ 'byung*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud la/ e waṃ gyi don ni yod dgos/ tshegs med 'dug pas/ don gang gi ston pa yin phebs pa la/ bdag gis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ bya bas ston lags/ bka' bstsal ba/ de ni gleng gzhi phun tshogs lnga'i/ ston pa phun tshogs dang*/ gnas phun tshogs gsungs pa yin mod/ gsol ba/ de kas e waṃ gyi don du 'gyur lags te/ e stong pa nyid la/ waṃ yig bde ba chen po bzhugs pa'i don de/ seng ge'i khri ni stong pa dang*/ skabs 'di'i sangs rgyas/ bde ba chen pos byed rgyu lags/ de skad gsol bas/ de nyid ni thugs la ldan pa'i tshul rang yang mi gnang bar/ bka' mchid gzhan gyi gleng bslang ba gnang byung*/ sang nyin bka' phebs pa ni/ khar sang 'phros 'phros byung ba de ka tsho cis kyang yin par 'dug spyan ras gzigs kyis de ka rang du gsungs yod/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan dag gis rtogs// bya ba yin pas/ kyai rdo rje las kyang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas// e waṃ rnam par bde chen po// dbang las yang dag shes par 'gyur// bya ba dang*/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga ni// e yi rnam pa'i cha byad gzugs// sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /bde ba can du rtag tu bzhugs// 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// zhes pa'i tshul rgyas par bka' bstsal zhing*/ drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor/ 'khor ston tha dad kyi bshad pa dang*/ nges don gdams ngag dang sbyor ba'i tshe na/ 'khor ston tha mi dad du gsungs pa ltar/ dgongs gcig rdo rje'i gsung las/ phun tshogs lnga rgyas par gsungs pa ltar yin/ zhes sogs nges don bshad pa mang du bka' bstsal bas/

nges don chos kyi dbang phyug dam par 'dug snyam du mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa byung*/ yang bka' bstsal ba/ sa bka' rnying gsum bstan pa'i snying po nges don gcig ngo shes pa la/ deng sang gi smra ba po rnams ni/ sdom gsum rab dbye na/ phyag rgya chen po la/ dgag pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad yod pa skad zer zhing tshig ris 'dri ba 'ang 'dug pa ci yin/ gsol ba/ sa skya'i lam 'bras sogs kyi chos kyi gnad dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnad ni/ gcig rang du yod lags shing*/ rje btsun grags pas/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi tshig las/ gnas lugs brjod du mi shes pas// brjod med kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /ces gsungs la/ spyir gyi snang ba sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rten 'brel/ rten 'brel brjod bral/ zhes pa'i lam bsgom lugs 'di/ spyir bka' brgyud kyi babs dang*/ dgos 'bri gung dgongs gcig dang ni rang 'grig rang du 'dug pa'i rgyas bshad/ dgongs gcig gi tshig 'di dang 'di 'byor sogs dang*/ sa paṇa rang gi phyag rgya chen po mig thur gyi lo rgyus dang*/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i mgo rang na/ ye shes phyag rgya chen po dang*// zhes 'byung*/ smad na'ang*/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni// dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*// rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las// byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin// zer ba sogs yod tshul phul bas/ 'o na rgya nag hwa shang gi lugs su 'dug zer ba dang*/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po dang*/ khyed kyi zer ba ci yin/ dbang las byung na/ rang byung zer ba dang mi 'gal lam/ gzhan yang*/ nā ro chos drug dang*/ tsā ri'i gnas chen la/ dgag pa yod pa 'dra/ zhes bka' bstsal ba la/ gsol ba/ deng sang gzhan phyogs phal cher ni/ sa paṇa 'di la/ gdong gzan bcol nas/ bka' brgyud dang*/ rnying ma dang*/ jo nang pa'i lta ba rnams/ log chos yin pa/ hwa shang dang khyad med zer yin 'dug lags/ rje tsong kha pa'i lhag bsam rab dkar na yang*/

sa paṇa la zhal g.yar nas/ bod kyi sgom chen blun po hwa shang gi lta ba bsgom zer ba dang*/ chos su mi 'gro ba'i sdug rus la/ mi tshe stong zad byed/ ces sogs bka' bkyon shin tu che/ lam 'bras la khyad 'phags zer ba'i zol sbyar mdzad/ khong gi slob mas/ dkyil chog mang po'i nang du/ ci yang yid la mi byed pa la/ lus gnad dang lta stangs 'cha' ru 'jug pa/ dud 'gro'i rgyu rang yin pa/ de 'dra byed du 'jug par ma gyur cig ces sogs/ khong gi brtsams chos mang por/ sa bka' rnying gsum chos kyis nor mi nyan pa/ gsal sing sing la bkod 'dug lags/ sa paṇa dgongs pa ni/ khong dpon slob kyi de dang mi gcig nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sgom dngos gzhi'i dus/ ci yang yid la mi byed pa 'di ka lam 'bras kyi gzhung babs la yod/ sbyor drug la yang de ka yin/ rang phyogs mnga' bdag mai tri pas/ a ma na se nyer bzhi'i bstan bcos kun 'di'i rgyab rten yin/ rje ngor pas/ kyai rdor rnam bshad du yang*/ 'di tshad ldan du mdzad yod lags kyang*/ khong rnams 'di rdzun mar 'dod/ a ma na se bya ba/ yid la mi byed pa'i don yin/ sa paṇa gyis dbang las byung zhes gsungs pa/ dbang la brten nas/ dang po nas rang chas su yod pa de myong ba la 'char ba'i don de kas rang byung yin gyi gsar byung min/ ye gdod ma nas rang rang gi rgyud la shes par grub pas// ye shes bya ba lags/ bde stong gnyis med gcig tu song bas/ gnyis med ye shes bya/ sa bka' rnying gsum dgongs pa gnyis med ye shes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ bde gshegs snying po/ mi rtog chos sku/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gcig kho na ru bzhed pa/ spags dang*/ zan dang*/ pol ta dang*/ bshos sogs/ don gcig pa dang 'dra bar bzhed pa lags/ 'di byin rlabs dang*/ dbang las nyams su myong ba'i lung ni/ kyai rdor brtag gnyis las/ 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir/ kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu// zhes 'byung*/

rnam rtog chos sku zer mkhan tsho yang*/ rnam rtog gi gshis de bde stong zung 'jug tu yod pa/ dbang dus ngo 'phrod pa de la bya/ rang re 'bri gung pa/ mi rtog chos skur bzhed pa/ yid la mi byed/ 'dzin med phyag rgya chen po/ bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab pa/ 'di gser mdog can pa'i yig cha na/ 'di la rgyas bshad rang yod lags shing*/ sa skya gong ma'i gsung rab na/ phyag rgya chen po chos sku'i ye shes/ rang sems rang rig rang gsal la/ byed pa 'di shin tu zhal gsal la/ sa paṇa lta bu'i mkhas pa 'di mi bzhed pa ga la srid/ deng sang khungs med kha 'khyam pa tsho/ sa paṇa la phar slob par 'dug lags/ yang khong gis/ blun po phyag rgya che bsgom/ sogs 'di ni/ bka' brgyud rjes 'brang dmangs ma ci ris pa 'dra/ dpon slob kyi rnam gzhag ma dgos shing*/ dbang yang ma dgos par/ phyag rgya chen po/ rnam rtog chos sku yin zer mkhan tsho la/ lung bstan mdzad par 'dug lags/ don la rang re'i grub mtha' dang*/ sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa gcig tu 'dug lags pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sa paṇa gyis/ spyir phyag chen ye shes la bzhed pa dang*/ khyad par dbang bskur dus su/ ngo 'phrod/ de rjes bsgom par gsungs la/ nged rang gi dgongs gcig na/ mdo sngags kyi khyad par dbang bya ba 'dug lags shing*/ lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan bya ba'ang 'dug lags/ chen po gsum gyis ma reg pa'i rtogs pa/ zhes 'byung la/ rtogs pa'i don ni/ rang rig ye shes nyams su myong ba la bya dgos/ 'di myong ba'i tshe na/ mgo thog la bum pa ma bzhag kyang*/ nges don gyi dbang thob pa 'dra bsam lags/ zhus pas/ skyob pa shin tu mnyes nas bka' bstsal ba/ de de ka rang yin par snang snang*/ sa paṇa lta bu'i mkhas pa la/ dgongs pa de 'dra zhig 'ong thang bsam pa yod/ gser mdog can pa'i grub mtha' de/ bka' brgyud kyi srog shing rang du yod pa 'dug a ho/ sa bka' rnying gsum/ lta grub bzang po 'dis ma bslus/

de lta bu rang red de lta bu rang red/ ces gsungs shing*/ thugs khar phyag thal mo gnang ba dang*/ spyan zim me dar gcig dgongs pa la bzhugs so// slad ma'ang bka' bstsal ba/ khyed kyang*/ nang nges don gyi paṇṭi ta rang du 'dug kho bo'i yongs 'dzin/ shrī dbang ratna dang*/ mang thos dkon mchog ratna'i gsung rnams dang*/ don gcig tu 'bab kyin 'dug nged kyi sgrub sde sogs na/ rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa dang ldan pa 'dra yod kyang*/ tshig gi brjod lugs ji ltar gsung ba de 'dra re byung na/ khrol khrol 'gro ba dang*/ bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa 'di la khyad par rang che ba 'dug ste/ rtogs ldan gyi go ba de lta bu dang*/ nges don gyi dbang thob tshul de lta bu cis kyang yin/ nā ro chos drug ces bya'i khrid/ mi la yan chad de las med/ ces sdom gsum rab dbye'i don ji ltar du 'chad/ ces bka' bstsal ba dang*/ nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid/ mi la yan chad de las med/ ces pa de/ rje mi la yin la/ chos de las lhag pa gzhan med/ de las zab pa'ang gzhan med/ nā ro chos drug rang zab/ nā ro chos drug rang lhag phyag rgya chen po bya ba'i khrid/ rje mi la'i dus na med/ de yan chad la yang ma byung gsung ba lags/ 'chad lugs 'di lta bu ma go zhing*/ gzhung yang ma dag pa la brten nas/ deng sang ni/ rang phyogs pa tsho yang*/ sa paṇa la the tshom zos/ gzhan phyogs pa ni sa paṇa bden/ gser mdog can pa'i legs bshad gser thur na/ 'chad lugs rjes ma 'di la/ dgag pa rgya chen mdzad yod lags/ spyir du yang*/ gser mdog can pa dwags po bka' brgyud la thugs dad gting nas che/ mnyam med sgam po pa dang*/ khams pa rdo rgyal dang*/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon rnams grub thob rtsod med du zhal gyis bzhes/ sgam po pa zla 'od gzhon nu'i sprul pa/ phag gru ind+ra bhu ti'i skye ba/ skyu ra 'jig rten gsum mgon klu sgrub kyi skye ba yin tshul rnams/

chos ra ru rgyun du gsung la/ gsung rtsom dpe cha na yang*/ gsal sing sing yod lags/ mtshan nyid pa phyogs gzhan dag dang*/ lag len pa phyogs phal mo che tsho ni/ mdzes mdzes tsam ma gtogs/ bka' brgyud kyi lta ba 'di hwa shang yin zer ba la/ ya yud med/ rje tsong kha dpon slob gang gsungs bla bor bshad nas/ yang*/ sa dge sogs kyi gtsang 'dzin pa skad rang mang lags/ bdag gi bla ma shākya mchog ldan gyi chos phran brgya rtsa na/ grub chen rdo rje rgyal po ni/ birwa'i chos kyis grol gyur nas// phyi nas phrin las skyong ba'i tshe// nā ro'i rjes 'brang gtsor mdzad la// sa paṇa mthing slad mdzad pa'i don// sogs/ 'di 'dra dang 'di 'dra rnams byung ba'i don ni/ rje phag gru pas/ thog mar sa chen la lam 'bras gsan/ phyis su mnyam med dwags po'i phyag chen la phrin las mdzad pa de la/ sa paṇa cung thugs yi ma rang bar/ mthing slad mdzad la/ mthing slad ni/ phal skad la/ skyon gtam zer ba ltar/ skyon 'dzin rgyu rang ma rnyed na'ang*/ snyad snyod 'dra gsung ba/ nā ro pa'i rjes 'brang mdzad na/ nā ro chos drug rang rtsal bton nas bskyong dgos/ phyag chen 'chad don med/ phyag chen 'chad na/ nges par du dbang yang bskur dgos mod/ mi la yan la/ nā ro chos drug rang gtso ba yin/ lar du/ lam 'bras kyang*/ ming btags sbas nas/ phyag chen gyi gseb la 'chad pa ma thang*/ zhes pa'i gsung*/ sa paṇa gyi lags/ rje phag mo gru pa ni/ lam 'bras dang*/ phug gcig pa la/ 'phral lag len gu dog dog po rang mi dgos pa'i phyag chen bshad pas/ slob ma rab 'bring tha ma kun/ 'jug bde zhing rtogs sla bas/ 'gro don rgya che ba yin gsungs/ shāka mchog pa'i dpe cha na yod lags/ deng sang ba tshos/ 'di tsho yi rang ma dgos par/ nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid/ mi la yan chad de las med/ mi la man chod la chos drug med pa'i go ba len pa dang*/ de las kyang blun zhing*/ chags sdang che ba tsho/

mi la yan chad de la med/ zer ba byas nas/ bka' brgyud la dmod pa ni sdig pa chen po gsog cing*/ la la sa paṇa la yang thugs blo ma tshad pa'i mthong byed pa tsho/ bdud kyi rjes 'brang red lags/ rang re sa bka' rnying gsum lta grub gcig pa la/ 'chad tshul gong du zhus pa/ de lta bu'i go ba rnyed na/ bde khrol ko khrol la 'gro zhing*/ blo sems gting nas bde ba zhig yod lags/ zhus pas skyob pa shin tu rang mnyes/ nga'i yongs 'dzin de rnams bka' drin che ba rang byung*/ lta grub kyi gnad gcig pa la/ dka' gnas mi 'ong ba/ 'di 'dra rang zhig dgos rgyu yin/ bstan pa'i nying khu/ khungs thub 'di 'tshol ba la/ nga la sngar tsa na dka' se byung*/ rje bka' drin 'khor med dwags po rin po che'i byin rlabs dang*/ nga rang gi bag chags bzang pos ma bslus/ yongs 'dzin bzang po rnyed/ dpal ngag dbang grags pa nas brgyud de/ chos khungs dang*/ rang re'i gdung rgyud gser gyi nyag thag gi rten 'brel dang*/ rin chen dpal nyid kyi bka' chems gser khang sgo bcad ma dang*/ sngon gyi smon lam la brten nas/ rang phyogs kyi yig sna tsho yang phyis bsog thub/ sngar thugs kyi phrin las sgrub sde dang*/ gsung gi phrin las bka' bstan 'gyur/ bka' brgyud gser phreng*/ spyi sgos kyi bka' 'bum sogs legs par grub/ da sku'i rten sgam po gdar gyi ri la drwa mig gi steng du mkha' 'gros gzigs lam du phab pa/ sngar gyi tsho las/ mi zhan pa zhig sgrub snyam pa yod/ zhib cha 'di rnams khyod la gleng chog pa/ rang re dpon slob lta grub la blo sems gcig tu 'dres byung bas bshad pa yin/ da dung zhib tu gleng 'os kyang yod la bstan pa'i bya ba'ang byed dgos gsung ba phebs/ yang skyob pas bka' bstsal ba/ sdom gsum rab dbye na/ ti se dang*/ tsa ri sogs la dgag pa yod pa min nam/ gser mdog pa'i legs bshad gser thur na/ rnying ma la dgag pa yod zer mkhan snang ba ci ltar yin/

bde mchog gi gnas chen/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ yul chen so bdun po la phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dag sbyor 'di ni shin tu gal che/ nges don la ni/ snang ba sems yin pas/ gang ltar bshad kyang mi 'gal mod/ drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor bshad tshod dang lag thog tu 'gel rgyu gnyis mthun pa zhig dgos kyin 'dug snang ba sems yin tshul la/ mi nyag sgom rin la/ snang ba med nas sems yin nam/ yod nas yin/ zhus pas ro stod la thal lcag rgyab nas/ lha rgan med nas sems yin mod gsungs/ skyob pa shin tu mnyes/ khong rtsa ba'i bla mar gyur/ bla ma ldum la/ snang ba sems yin na/ 'o na/ thub pa chen po chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin pa la/ byang chub kyi shing de/ da lta yang rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan na yod pa ci yin/ zhes zhus pas/ khong ma mnyes pa'i tshul gyis/ de'i lan 'di yin ma gnang bar/ sgom gyis/ de'i gnyer kha mi dgos gsung ba/ khong rang gis ma dgongs par 'dug rdo rje gdan dang*/ byang chub ljon pa'i shing sogs sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sangs rgyas nas/ da bar yod par snang ba'ang rang sems yin/ snang ba med nas sems yin/ de 'dra de da lta'i bar du 'dug pa snyam pa'ang*/ sems snang yin/ gsung na khong yang rtsa ba'i bla mar 'gro rgyu yin pa la zer ba dgongs gcig na yod/ yul chen so bdun bgrod pa'i tshe/ rdo rje gdan yang 'dren ni dgos/ de yang sems snang tsam yin pas/ don la ni med dgos rgyu yin pa 'dra/ dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i gling bzhi ri rab sogs/ mngon pa dang ma mthun pa la/ byang pa bdag chen la/ dge legs dpal bas brtsad pa'i lo rgyus grags pa su bden/ nges don la/ sems snang yin pas med kyang drang don du/ gnyis ka bden zer ram dus 'khor rang bden zer rgyu yin/ zhes sogs bka' mchid gleng mo mang ba phebs pa na/ gsol pa/ sdom gsum rab dbye na/ ti se dang*/

tsā ri la dgag pa gtan rang mdzad pa med/ ri bo gangs can dang*/ gangs ti se gnyis mi gcig de gnyis tha dad yin/ tsā ri tra lho phyogs na yod/ da lta'i tsā ri tsā gong mi gcig kyang*/ da lta'i tsā ri gnas chen yin pa/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas/ bha ṭa'i shing dang bcas pa bshad/ lha mo gnas mkhar dam/ de wā ko ṭa bya ba yin/ zhes pa/ sdom gsum rab dbye na/ gsal sing sing yod lags pas/ da lta tsā ri'i zhing skyong gnas pa'i shing de/ bha ṭa'i shing yin pas/ sa paṇa dang shin tu mthun pa lags/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro na/ 'di bshad pa/ bdag gis rgya dpe lañdza mthong bas nges pa gting nas rnyed lags/ ri bo gangs can 'dzam gling gi byang na yod/ de dang gangs ti se mi gcig gsungs pas/ ti se la mi gnod/ gangs ti se la gnas brtan yan lag 'byung 'khor bcas bzhugs/ gangs can ri rgyal na/ gnas brtan mi phyed pa dgra bcom lnga brgya dang bcas bzhugs pa/ 'di ka sdom gsum rab dbye na gtsang gsal tshig ris rang la yod/ deng sang gi rang gzhan mang pos don 'di ma go ba'i ca le co le/ sdom gsum gyi tshig la/ ti se min kyang ti 'dra yin/ bya ba yod pa skad byed/ yod med dpe cha la bltas na gsal lags/ zhes sogs 'di'i skor gyi dag cha mang du gsol zhing*/ bde mchog nas/ yul so bdun rnal 'byor pa'i lus la tshang*/ dus 'khor nas/ yul 'khor gcig la'ang tshang*/ 'dzam gling spyi la yang tshang*/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa la yang tshang bar gsungs pa thams cad mi 'gal/ bod yul la brtsi ba'i tshe/ gangs ti se ni/ hi mā la ya bya ba de yin/ hi ma ni gangs yin/ a la ya ni/ gnas gzhi'i ming yin/ 'di la dpa' bo bde mchog bzhugs/ nang lus la sbyor ba'i tshe/ spyi bo'i haṃ nas brgyud/ 'doms bar hi mā la ya zhes 'byung*/ 'dzam gling spyi la sbyor ba'i tshe/ byang phyogs ri bo gangs can la zer/ yang tsā ri ni bod la sbyor na/ de wi ko ṭa yin/

lus la sbyor na/ lte ba'i a shad tsaṇḍa lis bskyed pa'i mig gi rtsa la byed/ 'di na yum rdo rje phag mo bzhugs/ 'dzam gling spyi la sbyor na/ lho rta gdong gi me la byed/ mdor na gnas spyi bo'i ham̐ dang*/ sum mdo'i a shad gnyis la/ bde mchog yab yum bzhugs pa la/ rjes chags bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes na/ tshogs 'khor gyi mchog yin/ yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro de kas dgyes/ phyi ru ti se/ tsā ri sogs bskor ba yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes ched yin/ phag mo'i tshogs mchod dang*/ ma tha lag mchod tsam la'ang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bde chen mchod pas mnyes byed kyi go ba chags dgos par 'dug lags sogs zhus pas/ skyob pa shin tu rang mnyes/ legs so'i bka' bstsal dang*/ gzengs bstod brjod kyis mi lang ba phebs so// yang legs bshad gser thur na/ rnying ma la bstod ra yod tshul tsho zhib tu phul bas/ ches shin tu mnyes par gyur to// bdag gis kyang phyis su rje ā nanda nyid kyi bka' 'bum dang*/ khyad par cag ge rgyal mtshan bzang po'i zhus lan na/ nged dpon slob de dus zhu lan byung ba tsho/ brtag gnyis dus 'khor gyi lung dang bcas bkod pa gnang 'dug pa dang*/ gcig tu rang go bas dga' spro dang*/ dad pa sus kyang 'phrog mi nus pa/ ches shin tu che ba thob ste/ kho bo'i bla ma paṇa grub rnam gnyis/ grub mtha' dang dgongs pa gcig pa 'di lta bu'i phrin las bsgrub pa la/ skye ba 'di dang*/ tshe rabs thams cad du smon lam 'debs par gyur to// //maṅgalaṃ//
